mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Existing UE/PuerTS symbols cover input value access and movement components, but the frozen-state gate and horizontal movement contract need a behavior-level generated TS carrier.
mappings.migration_path: Move the frozen-state gate and horizontal movement call into a canonical PlayerMovement runtime module, keeping the generated file as the replayable scaffold.
thin_contracts: Read horizontal movement input only when the player is not frozen.
Apply horizontal movement across the room floor from the accepted input.
mappings.ability_binding: PuerTS bootstrap instantiates this ability for the player actor and binds the horizontal Enhanced Input action to execute movement only when is_frozen is false.
verification_evidence: When not frozen, left/right input changes player horizontal position.
When frozen, left/right input produces no movement intent.
Validation should observe Enhanced Input value read and CharacterMovementAdapter movement call.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: UE trace and damage calls are available, but the attack intent, short-range filtering, and enemy-only damage routing need a generated behavior-level carrier.
mappings.migration_path: Migrate attack input, trace parameters, and damage dispatch into a canonical PlayerCombat runtime module after prototype validation.
thin_contracts: Accept a melee attack request from the player.
Check a short close-range area in front of the player for the patrolling melee enemy.
Apply melee damage to the hit enemy.
mappings.ability_binding: PuerTS input dispatcher invokes this generated ability on attack_pressed; the ability performs the sphere trace and routes successful hits through DamageAdapter.applyMeleeDamage.
verification_evidence: Melee attack near the enemy produces a hit and damage event.
Melee attack outside short range does not damage the enemy.
Validation should confirm the attack input path, SphereTraceSingle call, and ApplyDamage call.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Input and movement component evidence exists, but dash gating, direction selection, and burst distance need generated behavior logic.
mappings.migration_path: Move dash tuning and frozen-state guard into canonical PlayerMovement runtime after validation.
thin_contracts: Accept dash input only when the player is not frozen.
Move the player a short burst distance in the current horizontal direction.
mappings.ability_binding: PuerTS bootstrap binds the dash Enhanced Input action to this ability; execution is ignored while is_frozen is true and otherwise launches in the current horizontal direction.
verification_evidence: Dash while not frozen briefly moves the player faster than normal movement.
Dash while frozen is ignored.
Validation should observe dash input binding and CharacterMovementAdapter.launchHorizontalDash.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Movement and timer symbols are available, but the freeze event, state mutation, movement block, and thaw scheduling require generated orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Promote freeze state and timer scheduling into canonical PlayerStatusRuntime with explicit event bus ownership.
thin_contracts: Enter frozen state when a freeze event is received.
Block player movement while frozen.
Schedule the frozen state to end after the short duration.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated runtime event bus invokes this ability on freeze_event; it sets is_frozen, disables movement, and schedules the thaw behavior.
verification_evidence: Freeze event sets the player frozen state.
Frozen player cannot move or dash until thaw.
Validation should confirm movement disable and thaw timer scheduling.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Movement restore evidence exists, but thaw event consumption and frozen-state mutation require generated runtime orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Merge thaw handling into canonical PlayerStatusRuntime with freeze timer ownership.
thin_contracts: End frozen state when the freeze duration expires.
Restore normal movement capability after thawing.
mappings.ability_binding: TimerAdapter.scheduleThaw emits thaw_pending into the generated runtime event bus, which invokes this ability to clear is_frozen and restore movement.
verification_evidence: After the freeze duration ends, the player can move again.
After thawing, dash input is accepted again.
Validation should confirm movement mode restore after the scheduled thaw.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Actor location setting exists, but patrol bounds, direction reversal, and defeated-state gating need generated behavior logic.
mappings.migration_path: Move patrol bounds and direction state into canonical EnemyPatrolRuntime after validation.
thin_contracts: Move the active undefeated enemy along a short horizontal patrol path.
Reverse patrol direction at path limits.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated enemy tick/update loop invokes this ability while enemy_active is true and is_defeated is false.
verification_evidence: Active undefeated enemy moves horizontally between patrol bounds.
Defeated enemy does not continue patrolling.
Validation should confirm SetActorLocation calls stop after defeated state.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Overlap query helpers exist, but close-threat state and active-enemy filtering need generated gameplay logic.
mappings.migration_path: Fold overlap threat checks into canonical EnemyThreatRuntime when collision setup is stable.
thin_contracts: Detect when the active enemy is close enough to the player to represent melee danger.
Expose the close-range threat state for avoidance and combat validation.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated enemy update loop invokes this ability to poll or bind overlap detection and publish melee_threat_active.
verification_evidence: Close player overlap marks the enemy as a melee threat.
No close overlap means no active melee threat.
Validation should confirm overlap helper output drives melee_threat_active.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Damage pipeline evidence exists, but health mutation and health_zero result publication require generated enemy health orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Move health state and damage-event routing into canonical EnemyHealthRuntime after combat validation.
thin_contracts: Receive melee damage from the player's successful strike.
Report whether the new health has reached zero.
mappings.ability_binding: DamageAdapter routes enemy_damage_event into this generated ability, which decrements health and emits health_zero when depleted.
verification_evidence: A valid melee damage event reduces enemy health.
Health reaching zero emits the health_zero result.
Validation should confirm ApplyDamage output reaches this health handler.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Actor tick disabling exists, but defeated state, threat shutdown, and exit unlock signal need generated orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Merge defeated-state handling into canonical EnemyHealthRuntime and route exit unlock through canonical RoomStateRuntime.
thin_contracts: Enter defeated state when enemy health reaches zero.
Stop the defeated enemy from acting as an active patrol threat.
Signal that the room exit is eligible to unlock.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated runtime event bus invokes this ability on health_zero; it sets is_defeated, disables enemy ticking, and emits exit_unlock_eligible.
verification_evidence: Enemy at zero health becomes defeated.
Defeated enemy stops patrol/threat behavior and enables exit eligibility.
Validation should confirm SetActorTickEnabled false and exit_unlock_eligible emission.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Overlap helpers exist, but player filtering and freeze/feedback event fanout require generated trap orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Move trap overlap and freeze event fanout into canonical TrapRuntime or RoomInteractionRuntime.
thin_contracts: Detect player overlap with the ice trap.
Emit a freeze event for the overlapping player and feedback systems.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated trap overlap hook invokes this ability; player overlaps emit freeze_event and freeze_feedback_event through the generated runtime event bus.
verification_evidence: Player overlap with the trap emits a freeze event.
Non-player overlap does not freeze the player.
Validation should confirm overlap detection and both freeze events are emitted.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Niagara spawn helper exists, but freeze feedback event subscription and player attachment selection need generated behavior logic.
mappings.migration_path: Move VFX asset selection and attachment policy into canonical FeedbackRuntime after visual validation.
thin_contracts: Receive the freeze feedback event.
Show a brief freeze visual effect attached to or around the player.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated runtime event bus invokes this ability on freeze_feedback_event, passing player_actor to the Niagara feedback adapter.
verification_evidence: Freeze feedback event spawns visible freeze VFX on the player.
The VFX is associated with the frozen moment only.
Validation should confirm Niagara spawn is attached to or around the player.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Camera shake helpers exist, but freeze feedback subscription and side-scroller-safe shake policy need generated behavior logic.
mappings.migration_path: Move camera feedback tuning into canonical FeedbackRuntime or CameraRuntime after validation.
thin_contracts: Receive the freeze feedback event.
Play a small brief camera shake without changing the side-scroller view.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated runtime event bus invokes this ability on freeze_feedback_event; it resolves the player controller and plays the configured small camera shake.
verification_evidence: Freeze feedback event plays a brief camera shake.
Camera shake does not alter room completion or player state.
Validation should confirm shake playback and unchanged side-scroller camera framing.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Overlap helpers exist, but locked-state gating and room completion denial require generated exit orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Move exit lock state and denial policy into canonical RoomExitRuntime.
thin_contracts: Detect when the player reaches the exit while the enemy is not defeated.
Deny room completion while the exit remains locked.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated exit overlap hook invokes this ability while enemy_defeated_false is true; it emits room_completion_denied instead of room_complete.
verification_evidence: Player reaching the exit before enemy defeat does not complete the room.
Locked exit state remains active while the enemy is undefeated.
Validation should confirm locked exit overlap denies completion.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Overlap helpers exist, but exit state transition from locked to unlocked and unlock eligibility routing require generated orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Move unlock transition and activation boundary ownership into canonical RoomExitRuntime.
thin_contracts: Change the exit runtime state from locked to unlocked when the enemy is defeated.
Use the exit overlap boundary as the activation point for the now-unlocked exit.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated runtime event bus invokes this ability on exit_unlock_eligible; it sets exit_unlocked and enables the exit overlap activation path.
verification_evidence: Enemy defeat changes the exit state to unlocked.
Unlocked exit can be activated by player reach overlap.
Validation should confirm exit_unlocked state and overlap activation readiness.

mappings.why_not_existing_framework: Overlap helpers exist, but unlocked-state validation and room completion mutation require generated room-state orchestration.
mappings.migration_path: Move valid exit reach and room_complete mutation into canonical RoomStateRuntime.
thin_contracts: Detect player reaching the exit activation boundary.
Mark the compact combat room complete only when the reached exit is unlocked.
mappings.ability_binding: Generated exit overlap hook invokes this ability when exit_unlocked is true; the ability emits room_complete through the generated room-state event bus.
verification_evidence: Player reaching an unlocked exit marks the room complete.
Player reaching a locked exit does not mark the room complete.
Validation should confirm valid_exit_reach produces room_complete only when exit_unlocked is true.
